order: Master Blueprint Section 14.3 Part A (RT3-C1) — persisted browser/DOM owner journey
how_it_was_driven: The REAL console, served by the REAL application, against a REAL database, behind a REAL cookie login. Only the identity PROVIDER is replaced, at the seam the shipped code already exposes (`useIdentityProviderForTests`): there is no WorkOS to call, and the fake signs genuine tokens with the local issuer so the production verification path runs unchanged. Every step below was performed by clicking the console's OWN buttons and filling its OWN form controls — the handlers that ran are the ones that ship, and each stage records the DOM that resulted. The in-app browser pane does not composite in this environment, so the clicks were dispatched programmatically onto the real DOM elements and the rendered DOM was read back; what is NOT proved here is the pixel-level pointer path, and that is stated rather than glossed.
